exposure: cortical depth at the level of the cingular sulcus
cohort: The participants were a group of preterm infants who underwent cerebral ultrasound at term-equivalent age.
finding: Abnormal gross and fine motor outcomes at 12-24 months corrected age in former premature infants are significantly associated with abnormal findings in the head ultrasound examination performed at term-equivalent age, reflecting both white and grey matter involvement.
